title: When Does an Added Planning Capability Create Operational Value? An Observable Evidence Standard
abstract: arXiv:2610.27305v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Industrial artificial intelligence (AI) planning systems combine predictive models, optimization logic, controls, and governance rules, but improvement in the complete policy does not show whether one addition made an independent contribution or whether that contribution justifies its burden. We address this attribution problem with an observable evidence standard that separates opportunity to act, executed-plan change, operational consequence, equivalence, uncertainty, and operating scope. Using forecast-to-plan replay on Favorita, M5, and Walmart data, we apply the standard to heterogeneous planning additions. Three limits of single-indicator evaluation emerge. First, a composite policy can conceal negligible component contribution: one control changed only 15 of 681 executed plans. Second, changing execution does not guarantee stable benefit: the evaluated multi-period capability helped in several long-lead settings but was 7.6% more

translated_title: 新增规划能力何时才能创造运营价值？一种可观测的证据标准
translated_abstract: 工业人工智能（AI）规划系统结合了预测模型、优化逻辑、控制机制与治理规则，但完整策略的改进并不能表明其中某项新增能力是否做出了独立贡献，也无法表明该贡献是否足以证明其付出的代价是合理的。我们提出一种可观测的证据标准来解决这一归因问题，该标准将行动机会、执行计划的变化、运营后果、等效性、不确定性以及适用范围区分开来。基于Favorita、M5和Walmart数据的预测到规划重放实验，我们将该标准应用于多种异构的规划新增能力，并揭示出单指标评估的三个局限。第一，复合策略可能掩盖微不足道的组件贡献：某项控制仅在681个执行计划中改变了15个。第二，改变执行并不保证带来稳定收益：所评估的多周期能力在若干长提前期场景中有所帮助，但在某些场景下却多付出7.6%的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出一种可观测的证据标准，用于判断工业AI规划系统中新增能力是否创造了独立的运营价值，并借此揭示单指标评估会掩盖微小的组件贡献、且执行计划的变化并不保证稳定收益的局限。
en_tdlr: Proposes an observable evidence standard for attributing whether an added planning capability in industrial AI planning systems creates independent operational value, revealing that single-indicator evaluation can conceal negligible component contributions and does not guarantee stable benefits from executed-plan changes.
